notes.title: Collaboration stage added
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871414/e49aa98859d46757f54e83ed3a749466f306d8ab.jpg[/img]
Collaboration stage “In search of adventure” has been added.
Hero of Frost and Royal Arcanist from “[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1004770/Maiden_and_Spell/]Maiden&Spell[/url]” will appear as bosses.
Please challenge them!

notes.title: Adjustment
notes.notes:
When the game is over in the last battle, player can spend money to learn to “Throw coins”.
It fires coins that can eliminate enemy bullets, making the fight easier.
The coin throwing can be used only in the last stage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871414/397c9d2b346854c5a1d22df3fe28b0be20ef0ec2.jpg[/img]

The cost of the battle technique “First Aid” has been lowered and the amount of recovery has been increased to 2.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that caused shots to not stop when entering a conversation with Tamahagane shoot.
Added illustrations to the art book.

notes.title: Collaboration stage added
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871414/1d1c4487a8c77545d8543ff9bb78f4cb7559f470.jpg[/img]
Collaboration stage “Starving Gladiator” has been added.
Alisa and Shibainu from ZephyrStudio's “[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1660290/_/]Monmusu Gladiator[/url]” will appear as bosses.
Please challenge them!

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Adjustments
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that caused the event to stop progressing in rare cases after the last boss was defeated.
Fixed a bug that the iai gauge did not return to the value at the time of entry when retrying.
Added button to change character, Iaijutsu, and Ultimates when retrying.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871414/5afad7d8ab147424c928092ec3f9ee8c28a63ac4.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
The following bugs have been fixed.
[list]
[*] The UI overlaps when the pause menu is opened before learning a skill
[*] When player go into a pause or conversation while in tamahagane, it will not return as a ball
[*] Prevention of retry and retire button mashing
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes/Adjustments
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that the BGM volume for boss battles could not be adjusted.
Fixed a bug that the sound crackling is suppressed when firing at high speed.
Fixed a bug that caused the reinforcement screen to appear twice in the training area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871414/2f2f543ee57fb3e8db1cb8fd66754a9ddfb9fe00.jpg[/img]
Added a button to turn off screen shaking.

notes.title: Yuri Sword Saga has been released!
notes.notes:
I will continue to update the game with additional stages and bug fixes.
If you have any comments or questions, please post them on the bulletin board.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871414/7d24eeaa6610c53ab1b1df42e601345a66d83ed7.jpg[/img]
Please continue to support this work.

notes.title: Video Submission Guidelines
notes.notes:
Video distribution is welcome for the entire game.
Please note the following

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871414/0ed58a52f4ae06752357fa8ec048b66aa4a0f23f.jpg[/img]

The game contains scenes with body defects and high exposure, as shown in the images.
(No genitalia or nipples are depicted.)
Please introduce the store page when you distribute the video.
Please post a review of the game, even if it is just a few words.

notes.title: Yuri Sword Saga released 11/23 (0:00 JST)!
notes.notes:
Thank you for your patience. Yuri Sword Saga has finally been released.
Please watch the journey of Kuroyuri and Shiroyuri to exterminate demons until the end.

[h2]Collaboration stages will be added![/h2]
Collaboration stages featuring characters from other indie games will be added for free.
Which titles will be collaborated with is yet to be determined, so please wait for the announcement in X.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871414/a86820aae4ea22b23574535e47423c11ac23513d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Cursor disappearing when mouse operation is performed in the pause menu fixed.
Volume of some sounds adjusted.

notes.notes:
・Chinese language added to the demo
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871414/74d061cae598ee91e175ac05b85c23666fb81451.jpg[/img]

・Added easy-to-understand effects and sounds when the sword is broken and recovered.
・Added a drop item that recovers the iai gauge when the boss HP is reduced.

notes.title: Demo Version Released
notes.notes:
Demo version has been released.
You can experience the first stage of the game.
There is a thread for the trial version, so if you have any bugs or suggestions, please write a post.

notes.title: "Yuri Sword Saga" store page is now open!
notes.notes:
This side-scrolling shoot-em-up game is set in a beautifully rendered Japanese world and features action in which players slash enemies and bullets with sword.
